Verify a combined filter (2-3 Lakh price, Mahindra brand, 2011 year, sorted low to high) restricts and orders the listing correctly.

Expected: Every listed tractor should be priced 2-3 Lakh, be a Mahindra, be model year 2011, and be sorted low to high.
